core_obligations: Inductive stage: left decomposition applied twice; the triangle is glued using the homotopy-improvement engine.
Splitting short exact sequences export the required properties; homotopy lifting repairs square commutativity.
Final stage: an explicit two-term complex closes the surjectivity gap; f + g finishes the assembly.
proof_roadmap: Build the system stage by stage from the two engines; repair commutativity by homotopy lifting.
Close the final surjectivity gap with the explicit two-term complex and the f + g map.
difficulty_reason: Induction assembled from two named engines with explicit homotopy lifting at every stage; no omissions.
